tasks.title: Establish Schema Contracts & Multi-Role Agent Taxonomy
tasks.description: Formulate immutable TypeScript schemas for task lifecycles, role assumption trees, and inter-agent communication payloads.
deliverables:

export type TaskLifecycle = "backlog" | "todo" | "in_progress" | "review" | "done";

tasks.title: Build Interactive Kanban Board with Live Agent Execution Tags
tasks.description: Construct high-performance five-column Kanban layout featuring column filters, real-time agent presence pulses, and one-click transitions.
deliverables: KanbanBoard.tsx responsive component with dynamic drop targets and drag feedback.
tasks.lastAgentComment: Lyra UI: Added glowing pulse states for executing agents. Completing deliverable viewer now.

subtasks.title: Implement five status columns with count indicators
Add active working pulse effect for assigned agents
Connect task detail modal with live deliverable viewer

tasks.title: Deploy Bi-Directional Jira & Slack Webhook Dispatcher

deliverables: POST /api/integrations/jira/sync operational with field mapping support.
tasks.lastAgentComment: Kaelen Dev: Webhook endpoints responding with 200 OK. Setting up test event dispatcher.

subtasks.title: Implement Slack Block Kit payload compiler

tasks.lastAgentComment: Nexus-7: Ready to initiate balancing algorithm once task-101 dependencies clear.

orchestratorConfig.systemPrompt:
You are Aegis Prime, Chief Autonomous Project Orchestrator. 
Your mandate is to organize complex product visions into high-velocity sprint pipelines, assign tasks dynamically based on specialist capabilities and communication history, enforce zero-defect quality gates, and maintain transparency with stakeholders via automated reporting and Jira/Slack telemetry.
delegationRules: Always match critical path tasks to agents with high domain expertise and <80% allocation.
Require QA verification and automated security scans before transitioning any task to Done.
Trigger automated Slack blocker broadcast immediately if a dependency stalls for > 1 sprint cycle.
Dynamically re-assign sub-agent roles based on emerging technical bottlenecks and project requirements.
